description: Features
Added full theme support. Pick from built-in themes, community themes, and themes shared by your server, all under Personalization.

Added a modern home screen and a modern details screen, both now the default. Home rows show a large focused card with artwork and details, and the details screen gained a backdrop blur and opacity slider.
Added new Media Bar styles. Choose between Moonfin, MakD, Bookshelf, Gallery, and Banner, or turn the Media Bar off entirely.
Added custom home rows from Seerr, IMDb, TMDb, MDBList, and Letterboxd, configurable from the server plugin or on the device.
Added Favorites, Genres, Collections, Playlists, and Audio home rows with sorting options that sync with your other Moonfin clients.
Added Since You Watched and Rewatch home rows, with local recommendations and a TMDB fallback.
Added a Shuffle screen for shuffling a library or a genre.
Added video scrubbing with fast forward and rewind at multiple speeds.
Added Upcoming Calendar rows powered by Radarr and Sonarr.
Added default audio and subtitle language preferences, which now also pull from your server profile on startup.
Added TMDB episode ratings, and ratings now follow the sources you picked in settings.
Reorganized settings to match the other Moonfin clients, and rebuilt the Quick Connect sign-in flow.
Search is much faster, returning results in about three seconds instead of ten.
The Jellyseerr integration is now called Seerr throughout the app.
Translations moved to the Moonfin Weblate instance, so the app is easier to translate into your language.
Bug Fixes
Fixed several crashes, including boolean type mismatches in settings, Seerr settings sync, shuffling a library or genre, and IMDb rows with empty parameters.
Removed the HSS and KefinTweaks integrations, which fixes the app crashing at launch when HSS was enabled on your server.
Fixed the focused item on the modern home screen rendering behind the focus card, and the card staying hidden on single item rows.
Fixed the wrong backdrop appearing when moving quickly across the home screen, and backdrops disappearing on focus changes.
Fixed hidden Continue Watching and Next Up items still showing, and corrected Recently Released row placement when using multiple servers.
Fixed multi-server playback routing, along with default audio and subtitle track selection.
Fixed choosing an audio track on the details page not sticking, so your pick is now used for playback.
Fixed navigating back to the sidebar from the modern details screen tabs.
Updated for Jellyfin 12 compatibility, covering the new authentication headers and item counts.
Contributions
Media Bar styles, modern home row polish, video scrubbing, Quick Connect sign-in, and many fixes
